entries.anchor: Batch Step 1: Commit — nothing to commit
entries.rationale: review-issue 1.17.0 lands per-member fix: batch-review fixes (#N) commits plus at most one batch-level commit; the old 'at most one' wording could make an agent treat a per-member fix commit as an anomaly or extra member (#946).

entries.anchor: 0. The ci-parity gate — once per tree (ai-dossier#1259)
entries.rationale: Ship Step 1 re-ran the full ci-parity matrix even when review applied no fixes. It now skips only when the clean HEAD^{tree} equals a recorded passing gate_tree (local stamp or trusted runstate), logging ci_parity=cached; it runs before the planning-doc removal so the tree is clean.
